QuestInfo.name: Eurenth's Favorites 2
QuestInfo.0: Ask #bTonero#k if there is anything else that Eurenth likes.
QuestInfo.1: Eurenth has a pet named #bPopo#k. Perhaps the old man will open up if you treat his animal companion well? Get #b50 Dinodon Ribs#k from #rDinodon#k in the #bForest of Coexistence#k and give them to #bPopo#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Eurenth a gift, but he is still ignoring you.

0.msg: #b(Tell him how poorly things are going with Eurenth.)#k\r\n

1.msg: Then try, try again, we shall! Eurenth lives alone save for Popo, his pet and sole companion. I suspect this Popo is the key to Eurenth's heart.\r\n

2.msg: Get #b50 #i4036157:# #t4036157:##k items from the #rDinodons#k in the #bForest of Coexistence#k and give them to #bPopo#k. This is certain to work!\r\n

yes.0: I shall continue to linger here should you have further use of me.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

0.msg: You ever eat a perfectly grilled Dinodon Rib? Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside...\r\n

1.msg: #b(Eurenth takes the ribs, cooks them, and eats them... without sharing a bite with either you or Popo.)#k\r\n

2.msg: #b(Popo is watching him with big, sad eyes, but Eurenth doesn't seem to notice. Actually, Eurenth is looking Popo right in the face while he eats...)#k\r\n

3.msg: Popo hungry... Why Popo no get food...?\r\n

4.msg: #b(Tonero did say he would be waiting. Return and ask him for more advice.)#k\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k
